_comment: Canonical, tool-agnostic source of truth for MCP servers. install.ps1 translates these into VS Code (user mcp.json) and Copilot CLI (~/.copilot/mcp-config.json) formats. 'kind' is 'stdio' or 'http'. 'targets' selects which tools receive the server. Secret values use ${input:ID} (VS Code prompts; CLI resolves from environment/.env at install time) or ${env:NAME}. The token ${repoRoot} (in stdio command/args/env) is replaced with this repo's absolute path at install time so local servers stay portable across machines.

inputs.description: GitHub Personal Access Token for the GitHub MCP server

brain-mcp._comment: Local-only. Wraps the Memories app (mcp/memories) over stdio. The app must be running on port 3466 (see mcp/memories/start-server.ps1); memories persist as files under mcp/memories/memories-storage so they can be committed.

spec-workflow._comment: Local-only, brain-mcp-backed. Drives spec-driven development: interview-based spec generation and per-spec task state. Specs are stored as linked notes in the 'Tasks & Specs' section of brain-mcp.
